scope: synthetic offline whole-clip noncausal two-channel WPE comparison at a task-local opt-in, unregistered, disabled-by-default waveform adapter boundary; no processor exposure, installed provider, real-room, listening, device, acceptance-threshold or release claim

format.grid_note: The 160-sample grid freezes fixture chunk shapes only; the whole-clip WPE reads the complete buffer and is never a real-time boundary claim. The installed v0 remains 16 kHz mono f32 at 160 samples/frame.

public_boundary.registration: none; this task adds no C provider, descriptor, registry entry, installed default or public catalog entry
public_boundary.c_boundary_skip_reason: the hard write scope permits only this task-local evidence directory; provider/tests/ and shared build files are out of scope. OFF/ON behavior is exercised at the opt-in Python adapter instead.
public_boundary.note: No C ABI, header, descriptor, default, registry or installed v0 source is modified. The Python adapter is opt-in, unregistered and disabled by default.

invariants: Fixed v0 grid only for fixture chunk shapes: 16 kHz, two synthetic channels, f32, 160-sample chunks; the installed ABI, descriptors, registry, defaults and mono v0 behavior are unchanged.

The WPE is explicitly whole-clip and noncausal: predictors are estimated from every frame of the buffer. It is never a real-time claim, never an oracle and never an acceptance threshold for online work.
No C provider, CMake subtree, descriptor setting, registry entry or installed default is added by this task; the C boundary is intentionally skipped and documented.

Identity/noisy controls, paired synthetic SI-SDR/STOI, three synthetic RIR stratifications, early-reflection target, movement and overlap controls, clean-source preservation, blocked missing-reference and no-reference-suppressor results are all present; no missing result qualifies the candidate.
Rejections for nonfinite, wrong shape, out-of-range, stale session/epoch/position and bad config fail closed without mutating DSP state.
Exact pinned comparisons use three byte-identical cold-start repeats; no tolerance widening, oracle substitution or provider substitution is used.
Pinned adjacent mono results are read only as explicitly scoped noncausal/causal controls and are never this task's oracle, threshold or candidate result.
All scores are synthetic scoped; no real speech, model weights, downloads, licensed runtime, listening, MOS/STOI on real speech, target-device pacing or release qualification is claimed.
Measured regressions are reported as measured; the candidate is not qualified and the decision is DEFER.
source_evidence_statements: candidate_matrix.csv: WPE offline/online/multichannel is an evaluated dereverberation candidate with synthetic screens and mixed outcomes, not an installed SDK provider.

adapters/wpe/README.md: 512-point FFT, 128-hop, 5 taps, 8-frame delay and roughly 80 ms algorithmic latency; the documented offline use is not real time. This task freezes a 2-frame prediction delay and whole-clip statistics instead and claims no real-time behavior.

REALTIME_COMPONENT_CANDIDATES.md: stateful frame-causal online single-channel WPE has measured RTF and estimated delay with negligible gains over identity; these are source findings, not results reproduced here.
research/dereverberation_candidates_20261028.md: WPE outcomes depended on room and matched scoring; these synthetic conditions are a comparison, not a selection or qualification.
blockers: No held-out real-room or standards-room paired dereverberation evaluation with pinned RIR provenance, rights and a defined early-reflection target has been run.
No listening/MOS assessment on licensed real speech has been run; synthetic STOI is not a human score.
No whole-clip timing, CPU, memory or device measurement has been run; the algorithm is noncausal and cannot support a realtime claim.
No provider intake, rights, license, descriptor and public catalog review has been completed for any provider.
The room profile's delayed/missing render case is not applicable to this dereverberation fixture and stays open for any AEC-style qualification.
reopening_conditions: Provide real-room or standards-room RIRs with pinned provenance and a defined early-reflection target, then rerun paired SI-SDR/STOI with identity and noisy controls.
Run listening/MOS with licensed real speech and a declared listener protocol.
Develop and measure a genuinely causal multichannel variant on the exact target device before any realtime provider proposal.
Complete provider intake, license and descriptor review before changing any installed default, registry or public catalog.
Add a separate render/echo-return fixture before claiming any AEC-style duplex capability.
